outcome: Clinical characteristics of diabetes in pregnancy
Maternal outcomes (gestational hypertension, spontaneous abortion, LGA neonates)
cohort: 178 pregnant women (32 with overt diabetes and 146 with GDM) attending tertiary care hospitals over 2.3 years
finding: Women with overt diabetes in pregnancy had a higher risk of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including gestational hypertension, spontaneous abortion, large for gestational age (LGA) neonates, and progression to postpartum diabetes, despite achieving comparable glycemic goals to those with GDM.
